newsitem.title: FRANCE: Framatome says interested in Westinghouse energy.
newsitem.headline: Framatome says interested in Westinghouse energy.

text.p: French nuclear engineering company Framatome said in a statement that it was interested in the nuclear energy activities of Westinghouse Electric Corp but said there were no talks.

"Framatome has been informed about the interest of GEC Alsthom for the conventional energy activities of Westinghouse, this interest -- parallel to Framatome's interest for the nuclear activities -- would strengthen the French position in any possible restructuring in this sector," the company said in a statement.
Earlier, company secretary-general Phillippe Raulin had "formally denied" the company was preparing an offer for the Westinghouse nuclear activities.
